| [SYNTHESIS-023](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-023.md) | The authenticity line holds, set aside, that a will is the agent's own to the degree its commitments arise through, remain integrated with and are answerable to its constitutive organization, and that this grounds normativity from a whole to its constituents but not between peers; it was deferred because its ownership criteria do not survive manipulation, and what it has gained since is a candidate content for "integrated", non-domination of the processes that carry a commitment, with the objection that non-domination cannot be read from low supervisory cost, or from override alone, but only under intervention, when a constituent dissents, or from history |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-047](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-047.md) | A collective that replaces all its members, or a self that goes inactive, persists on the record's account by causal transmission of the organization that produces it or by the capacity to reinstate it, not by resemblance or a running quantity: persistence has senses that come apart, its successors can be plural without identity branching, what must be transmitted is still open, a slow variable belongs to a collective's dynamics only when its members read and regenerate it, and a feature recovered from members' activity is at most a constituent of a perspective |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-050](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-050.md) | Conferral among an organization's processes is any effect on another's share of future influence, and a grant is conferral through a maintained relation; how grants are counted and scored decides whether authority tracks reliability or entrenches: an accounting rule can keep an operator's authority independent of its own grants, trust can be the regularity of grants earned by being right, and when authority is scored against the interpretation it helped make dominant the same loop can amplify an initial advantage without fidelity, which in the linear model only the two-way coupling starts and independent scoring removes; capture runs through the evidence an evaluation receives or the criteria it weighs by, with different remedies, and the standard that would tell capture from merited trust is not supplied |  | Proposed |
| [SYNTHESIS-052](../../../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-052.md) | What a collective is credited with need not be what its members hold: an organized whole's operative intention is not the expectation of its members' intentions and its reasons can part from theirs; a diffuse population with no procedure can show a public stance or change an outside institution without a collective intention, whether the credit is then due to it is open, and composition and a group process are offered as routes by which its most committed or extreme members fix the stance; a person can be organized by a judgement attributed to a collective that does not hold it, governs themselves by making such a judgement's authority depend on its grounds, and that rule holds without qualification only for judgements of what already is; and whether a community of sound inquirers can settle on a belief none of them reasoned to is open, with model results whose tests in real communities are open questions | A part account of the distributed-agency line: the part on what is credited to a collective as against what its members hold.
